sys_one_extend_capability.description: Invoke when a new application with an attached resume needs to be parsed and scored against a specific job requisition. Input: resume file plus requisition ID. Output: a 5-factor weighted fit score (skills 30%, experience 25%, projects 20%, certifications 15%, education 10%) with per-factor explanation, computed after masking name, gender, photograph, and institution. Can only recommend SHORTLISTED or RECRUITER_REVIEW — never invoke this to reject a candidate.
sys_one_extend_capability.name: AEGIS Resume Intelligence
